about: P1-profile digests (ARCHITECTURE-P2 §0 rule 5, §9.3, §10.1 accept.p2.p1-digests), recorded from the unchanged engine at commit 7e623b9 before any P2 code. One entry per template and CCNA 1 lab: the fixed script of test/accept.p2.p1-digests.test.ts (boot, the reference solution, one ping, one show, runFor 600 s), the p0EventLine of every trace event of every kind, the typed CLI results, and hashes of the normalised end snapshot. Change it only as §9.3 allows, by re-recording the affected worlds with NF_RECORD_P1_DIGESTS.
